thread:
incident-bot: PAGING: elevated 5xx spike in lon-edge (region=lon1) — paging oncall @samuel.eng :rotating_light:

samuel.eng: seeing a sharp bump in 502/504s starting ~00:05 UTC. dash shows error rate ~18% for gateway-proxy lon-edge pool, increased p95 latency too.

kevin-sre: on it. any ingress change or deploy? I don't see any code deploys in the window.

samuel.eng: no deploys. traffic graph: https://grafana.redwood/graphs/edge/lon1 — filters: gateway-proxy, backend-504s.

mike-platform: quick first check: are backend mlworkers healthy? running curl to a sample route from inside the region..

mike-platform: ```
$ curl -v https://lon-edge-1.redwood.internal/health
* Connected to lon-edge-1.redwood.internal
< HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
{ "error": "upstream_connection_reset" }
```

julia.ops: looks like conn reset between proxy and backend pool. conntrack? ephemeral exhaustion?

kevin-sre: checking nat and conntrack on border nodes. `ss -s` shows many TIME_WAIT but not extraordinary. netstat conntrack count near threshold.

samuel.eng: logs from proxy: ```
2026-05-17T00:06:12Z gateway-proxy[pid=2334] ERROR upstream reset id=0x7f2a
2026-05-17T00:06:13Z gateway-proxy[pid=2334] WARN backend connection timeout 10s
```

kevin-sre: engaging rapid-evac playbook. shifting a portion of traffic off lon1 to eu-west1 to reduce load and test fallback. will update routing via edge-router.

ops-notify-bot: Notifying customers with active sessions in EU/UK about degraded performance in LON region. Template: "We're aware of elevated errors in LON; cross-region failover in progress." :loud_sound:

mike-platform: initiating weighted reroute 30% -> eu-west1 for gateway-proxy from lon1: ```
# edge-routerctl
set-weight lon1->gw-proxy 70
set-weight eu-west1->gw-proxy 30
```

samuel.eng: after reroute, error rate in lon1 dropped to ~11% and overall customer error rate dropped to ~6% within 90s. good first signal.

julia.ops: running health probes against backend pool members from lon1: many return 200 but a subset (approx 12%) return connection resets. suspect a transient network flapping to mlworkers.

kevin-sre: checking upstream firewall NAT translations — seeing SNAT port exhaustion on a subset of nodes. backlog on conntrack for ephemeral ports.

samuel.eng: can we add ephemeral port range bump for the affected nat nodes as emergency mitigation?

kevin-sre: yes, bumping on two gateway-nat nodes now: `sysctl -w net.ipv4.ip_local_port_range="1024 65535"` and increasing conntrack timeout for TIME_WAIT. applying via runbook.

mike-platform: also enabling prefix KV cache on gateway to reduce outbound connections to mlworkers for repeated requests. config change applied, rolling w/o restart.

ops-notify-bot: Updated customer message: "We're routing a portion of traffic to EU while we stabilize LON. Some users in UK may see routing via EU with slightly higher latency. We'll provide updates every 30 minutes."

julia.ops: after port-range bump and reroute, lon-edge error rate steadying ~3-4% now; eu-west p95 latency increased by ~40ms but acceptable.

customer-success: flagged 6 high-value customers experiencing timeouts earlier; CS team is sending interim notes and tracking support tickets. no major revenue-impacting customers reported full outage.

samuel.eng: moving to containment -> mitigation complete for now. will keep partial traffic steer active (70/30) for 45 minutes to verify stability.

kevin-sre: beginning brief post-incident data collection: list of affected nodes, conntrack dumps, NAT SNAT counters, proxy logs. saving artifacts to s3://incidents/7325554321/artifacts.tar.gz

mike-platform: next steps: 1) root cause spike looks like NAT/SNAT ephemeral port depletion on a subset of LON nat nodes causing upstream resets; 2) immediate mitigations: port range bump + traffic steer + cache reduction of backend connections; 3) follow-up: infra change to increase ephemeral range across pools, add alert for conntrack near-threshold, and investigate connection reuse on mlworkers.

julia.ops: handing off monitoring and follow-up to @julia.ops for the night shift. samuel you can wrap up once the reroute is removed and metrics stable for 30m.

samuel.eng: handing off to julia.ops — I'm stepping off once I see 30m stable. note: please open a P1 postmortem with timeline and customer impact summary.

ops-notify-bot: Customer-facing update scheduled in 25m with current mitigation summary.

julia.ops: ack takeover. I'll keep the channel open and notify if any regression. planning to roll the permanent kernel/conntrack sysctl and coordinate with infra tomorrow morning for config rollout.

incident-bot: RESOLVED: error-rate dropped to baseline and partial reroute manually reduced back to 95% lon1 / 5% eu-west after stability window (closing to monitoring). Tagging for postmortem. :white_check_mark:

samuel.eng: thanks all — filing initial incident notes and assigning postmortem to kevin-sre + mike-platform.

kevin-sre: copying logs and connection counters to the incident runbook. will propose a mitigation patch and an automated alert rule to prevent recurrence.

customer-success: will follow up with affected customers tomorrow morning with timeline and what to expect.

julia.ops: final: leaving channel open for 1 hour then archive. good handoff. :thumbsup:
